outgoing.name: 17th century
outgoing.excerpt: Contact with Europeans in the early 1600s had a profound impact on the economy of the Iroquois.

outgoing.name: Bean
outgoing.excerpt: The Iroquois peoples were predominantly agricultural, harvesting the " Three Sisters" commonly grown by Native American groups: maize, beans, and squash.

outgoing.name: Canada
outgoing.excerpt: Many Iroquois have been fully integrated into the surrounding Western economy of the United States and Canada.
